description:
[Deterministic CRMA supply chain risk screener. Pure calculation, read-only, side-effect free]. Screens product Bill of Materials (BOM) against the 34 EU Critical and 17 Strategic Raw Materials under Regulation (EU) 2024/1252, auditing single third-country concentration against the statutory 65% import dependency cap.
Usage: Use this tool to audit supply chain exposure to Lithium, Cobalt, Rare Earths, Gallium, and other critical minerals.
Returns: JSON object with { totalCriticalMaterialsMassGrams: number, criticalMassPercentage: number, strategicMaterialsCount: number, materialsProfiles: array, crmaGeopoliticalRiskRating: string, crma2030DiversificationCompliance: boolean }.

rawMaterialName.description: Mineral or metal name (e.g. Lithium, Cobalt, Neodymium, Gallium)

supplierCountryIso2.description: 2-letter ISO country code of primary supplier

name: critical_raw_materials_screener
